research_question: How reliable are off-policy estimators for real logged recommendation data, and can a transparent lower-confidence-bound rule prevent unsupported promotion of a learned challenger policy, when the reward model is fitted with a deterministic second-order optimizer appropriate for n_samples >> n_features?

source_and_split.archive: official ZOZO Open Bandit Dataset archive locked by obd_source_lock.json
source_and_split.reuse_rule: Study 2 reuses the exact source and temporal split from Study 1. Evaluation-period and Random-reference outcomes remain untouched at Study 2 lock time.

reward_model.rationale: Use a deterministic exact-Newton solver designed for n_samples >> n_features and one-hot categorical designs. This replaces the SAGA numerical method that failed in Study 1 while preserving the same penalized logistic objective and feature specification.
reward_model.automatic_lbfgs_fallback: not accepted as a successful training gate; any warning indicating newton-cholesky fallback or numerical instability terminates Study 2 before evaluation
training_gate_pass: no warning indicating numerical fallback or Hessian instability
all fitted coefficients and intercept finite
reward_model.training_gate_failure_rule: If any training gate criterion fails, Study 2 terminates as model_fit_failure. No solver, tolerance, regularization, feature, or iteration-budget amendment is authorized within Study 2.

features.user_features: All raw user_feature_* fields, one-hot encoded using BTS training levels only; unknown evaluation levels map to all-zero indicators for that field.
features.item_context: Archived candidate-action item_context; item_feature_0 numeric, item_feature_1..3 categorical one-hot.
features.candidate_affinity: Exactly user-item_affinity_{a} when scoring candidate action a; no non-candidate affinity columns in q(x,a).
features.numeric_scaling: Same BTS-training-only median, mean, and standard-deviation preprocessing as Study 1.

training_only_qualification.allowed_data: BTS training partition only, including training clicks needed to fit the model

target_policies.challenger_rule: 0.90 on the action with largest q_hat plus 0.10/80 on every archived action; exact ties choose the lowest item_id

ope.implementation: reuse tested adaptive_policy_learning.ope primitives without semantic changes

bootstrap.method: paired moving-block bootstrap over evaluation rows ordered by timestamp

promotion_rule.promote_if: lower endpoint of the 95% bootstrap CI for challenger DR minus observed BTS value is > 0 AND challenger ESS/n >= 0.10

execution_sequence: merge this prospective Study 2 lock and training-gate implementation
run training-only qualification on the official archive
if and only if the training gate passes, freeze the successful coefficient hash and implementation provenance without reading evaluation outcomes
no_post_outcome_tuning: No change to solver, max_iter, tol, C, features, preprocessing, split, target support, epsilon, estimator, clipping rule, bootstrap, or promotion threshold after any evaluation-period or Random-reference outcome is loaded.
No secondary analyses before the Study 2 primary result is complete.
A failed Study 2 training gate ends Study 2; any redesign is Study 3.
outcome_visibility_at_lock: No BTS evaluation-period click outcome, Random reference-window click outcome, OPE estimate, challenger value, or promotion decision has been read or computed in either Study 1 or Study 2.
